blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A spokesperson for the House prosecution has expressed belief that the evidence against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s alleged misuse of confidential funds could still lead to her conviction with the possible initiation of criminal proceedings outside the impeachment trial. Trial spokesperson and Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong cited the Commission on Audit’s (COA) final action on the notice of disallowance of millions of pesos in the Office of the Vice President’s confidential expenditures. “Malaki ‘yung possibility na based on the evidence, mukhang makakasecure pa tayo ng conviction on Article 1 sa confidential funds because of […]...
